services.name: Holiday Tour
services.desc: Join us for our special night time holiday cruise during the Festival of Lights Under London Bridge and Swim Across the Channel on November 27th. This event you can come on board as early as 5:30PM to watch the swim across the channel and the festival of lights from the comfort of the Dixie Belle as the full service bar will also be open, after the swim across the channel has all cleared up we will be leaving the dock at 7:00PM for a 1 hour night sky tour around the island. First tour after the Village lights are all lit up. $50 per Festival of Lights Holiday Tour

services.name: Parade Of Lights
services.desc: December 12th 2026 Parade of Lights. This is a limited seating event. Without a advance ticket you will not be allowed on board. This event WILL SELL OUT! Price is $90 each person. Special event no special pricing for children. Event will be from 5PM until finished so no end time guaranteed. You may arrive at 4:30 until 5:20. If you are late you will miss the boat. The boat will leave at 5:30 sharp. NO REFUNDS. If weather permits the Dixie Belle to leave the dock we will be participating in the parade of lights, however if weather does not permit you will be a spectator and enjoy the show on 2026 Dixie Belle parade of lights

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: $1600 per hour with 2 hour minimum. Most popular choice with a combination of a cruise and some time dockside for setup, boarding, decorating or just hanging out in the beautiful channel next to the bridge with the best view in Havasu. Call us to schedule your private charter. 2 Hours minimum required • Up to 131 people • Great for all occasions! Full cash/credit bar!

services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: Enjoy an approximately 1 hour relaxing tour around the island to watch the beautiful Havasu sunsets. Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure, boarding continues up until scheduled departure time, please arrive anytime in that 30 minute window to board the Running Tours All Year · Havasu Sunset Tour

services.name: 2027 Balloon Fest Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a early morning ride watching all the BalloonFest balloons in the sky. Tour is approximately 90 minutes, we do not have a destination, we will be chasing balloons so captains will be going wherever we can get to balloons! Heaters will be on inside the boat, hot beverages, full cash/credit bar for Mimosas, Bloody mary's or your drink of Early morning tour watching the balloons in the air.

services.name: Valentines day dinner cruise hosted by Stoney's.
services.desc: Special Valentine's dinner hosted by Stoney's will consist of Appetizer of their signature meat balls. Side salad with spring mix with dried berries and pecans with feta cheese topped with balsamic glaze. Main course will be Lobster with oven, lemon herb, roasted potatoes, and asparagus and desert will be included. There is a full bar on board outside drinks are not allowed. Special Valentines sunset cruise will be approximately 1.5 hours. Boarding will begin at 5:00PM February 14th and the boat will leave promptly at Valentines day dinner cruise hosted by Stoney's limited seating.

services.name: Mother's day brunch tour
services.desc: Special Mother's day brunch hosted by Stoney's! Boarding begins at 9:30AM and Dixie Belle will leave promptly at 10AM to enjoy all the serenity Lake Havasu has to offer on this tour. Bring your Mom, Wife, or special someone on this relaxing cruise. Brunch will be French toast with fruit topping and whipped cream, scrambled eggs, served with sausage and bacon. There is a full bar on board to enjoy a cocktail, beer, wine or soda of your choice while you Special Mom's day 90 minute cruise includes a special gift for Mom.

services.name: 2027 New Years EVE Cruise!
services.desc: Dixie Belle tradition to be the last boat under the bridge in 2025 and the first boat under the bridge in 2026. Celebrate New Years on the water, Celebrate new years while in the middle of the lake. Will include a complimentary midnight champagne toast. Boat leaves the dock at 11:00PM and returns at 12:30 AM after the new year. You can begin boarding at 10:30PM. Full cash/credit bar on NEW YEARS EVE CRUISE!

services.name: Dinner Cruise by Stoney's
services.desc: Enjoy the sunset and a dinner cruise on the Dixie Belle. Approximately 90 minutes long. Only 30 tickets will be sold for this event. DO NOT BE LATE! Dinner will be provided by and served to your table by Stoney's, dinner will include a appetizer, side salad and a dessert, main course will be Smothered Pork Chops with a mushroom onion cream sauce over mashed potatoes and Brussel Sprouts. This dinner will not Dinner cruise, approximately 90 minutes.
